# BlackRock Advisor Center

Skills that teach agents to work with BlackRock Advisor Center. They are copied from the vendor's repository, [blackrock/advisor-center-agent-skills](https://github.com/blackrock/advisor-center-agent-skills), at commit `591c758`.

BlackRock Advisor Center 360° skills for AC360 capability routing, guided benchmark selection, guided portfolio building, portfolio observations and opportunities, wealth projections, and portfolio

## Install

- **BoldCreate Connect:** open **Marketplace**, find **BlackRock Advisor Center**, and click **Install**.
- **Cursor:** add this repository as a team marketplace, then install **BlackRock Advisor Center**.
- **Claude Code:** `/plugin marketplace add syncfusion/BoldCreate-Plugins`, then `/plugin install blackrock-advisor-center-plugin@boldcreate-plugins`.

## Skills

6 skills: `ac360-capability-router`, `guided-benchmark-selection`, `guided-portfolio-builder`, `portfolio-observations-and-opportunities`, `portfolio-review`, `wealth-projections`.

## Setup

No install-time settings.

## Before you install

It ships no scripts. The skills are guidance for the agent.

## Docs

- Vendor repository: https://github.com/blackrock/advisor-center-agent-skills
